title: •Colonel Feyn Gospic
caption: •Colonel Feyn Gospic (V)
lore: One of General Dodonna’s chief strategic advisors. Planned the Rebel fleet’s approach to the Death Star.
game_text: While Massasi Base Operations on table, opponent may deploy only one Imperial to each Yavin 4 site per turn. Doubles Rebel Tech bonus to Attack Run. Once per turn, may ▲ Balanced Attack or a commander.
